setup: Drive every allowed normal, retry, review, ambiguity, quarantine, and release transition.
assertion: Queued -> PendingCommit -> Held -> ReviewMarked -> AmbiguousHeld -> Quarantined -> Released is closed, with only documented skipped transitions and one successor-free obligation.

setup: Exit normally or by definite pre-effect failure from root/nested/branch/item lease scopes.
assertion: Exact tickets release and capacity restores before Return, merge, parent continuation, or terminal progression.

setup: Cancel before reservation, after reservation before workflow activation, and after activation.
assertion: Queued winner has zero tickets; pre-activation compensates exactly once; post-activation follows proven release or quarantine without erasing tickets.

setup: Crash/lost-response around leased attempts and redispatch on another host.
assertion: Operation, attempt, deadline, token, ticket identities, units, provider generations, and reserved capacity remain identical.
expectedRed: Persistent leased retry coordinate is absent.

setup: Timeout/fail a token-ignoring leased body while the process remains alive, then lose the host.
assertion: No policy retry overlaps the live body; host-loss may redispatch under the same obligation because the old local execution is gone.
expectedRed: Leased in-process retry exclusion is absent.

setup: Record ambiguous protected work then succeed on a retry.
assertion: Success does not erase ambiguity; scope cannot release until truthful proof or atomic quarantine transfer.

setup: Resume the Kubernetes journey with valid/invalid payload, UID, operation ID, token, and terminality.
assertion: The immediate post-Wait step validates all facts while lease context is present; only valid proof permits normal release.
expectedRed: Final scheduler lease validation is absent.

setup: Win invalid/unproven report, ambiguous exit, exhaustion, cancellation, deadline, termination, or abandonment while protected work may remain.
assertion: One atomic commit transfers tickets/token to Quarantined before failure/merge/parent/terminal progression; capacity remains reserved.
